summary: Tested new Users edit dialog, member reset-password flow, Renewals page rename, and New Registration form date fields. Backend RBAC for PUT /api/users/{id} and POST /api/users/{id}/reset-password is fully correct. UI works for member reset flow and admin/member roles. Found one regression: editing a super_admin user via the UI Save button returns 422 because frontend sends role='super_admin' but backend UserUpdate.role Literal only allows admin/member/manpower.
passed: super_admin login + member login work; sidebar respects roles
PUT /api/users/{id} as super_admin updates name/phone of member (200)
PUT /api/users/{id} as admin updates manpower phone (200)
PUT /api/users/{id} as admin on an admin target returns 403
PUT /api/users/{id} as admin trying role='admin' returns 403
POST /api/users/{id}/reset-password as member for LINKED manpower returns 200
POST /api/users/{id}/reset-password as member for UNLINKED manpower returns 403 ('Not your manpower')
POST /api/users/{id}/reset-password as member for non-manpower (admin) returns 403
Users page (super_admin): 9 edit-{id} buttons render; clicking opens dialog with edit-user-name/phone/role/contractor testids
Users page (member): only reset-pw-{id} buttons visible; no edit/toggle/delete buttons; reset modal submits and backend returns 200
/renewals page renders with heading 'Renewal Required' and renewals-page testid
/manpower/new form contains field-height_work_expiry_date and field-safety_belt_expiry_date date inputs

failed.issue: Saving the Edit dialog for a super_admin user returns HTTP 422. saveEditUser in Users.jsx posts {role: 'super_admin', ...} but backend UserUpdate.role Literal only allows 'admin'|'member'|'manpower'. Pydantic rejects with literal_error.
failed.evidence: Reproduced via UI (PUT /users/<id> status: 422) and curl: PUT /api/users/<sa_id> body={"role":"super_admin",...} -> 422 {"detail":[{"type":"literal_error","loc":["body","role"],"msg":"Input should be 'admin', 'member' or 'manpower'"}]}

failed.issue: Zero needs-{mid}-{field} badges visible on /renewals during this test. Data set currently has only one approved manpower whose medical was just renewed to 2027 and no manpower with height_work / safety_belt expiry within renewal window, so 0 badges may be expected. Could not positively verify badge rendering with real data.

action_items: Fix Users.jsx saveEditUser to either (a) omit `role` from the PUT body when target.role === 'super_admin' (or when unchanged), or (b) extend backend UserUpdate.role Literal to include 'super_admin' (super_admin-only enforcement is already in update_user logic). Option (a) is safer.
Optionally seed/create a manpower with height_work_expiry_date or safety_belt_expiry_date within 30 days (or expired) to positively confirm Renewals badges render with needs-{mid}-{field} testids.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (edit-save broken for super_admin target; renewals badges not exercised)
